hypotheses.hot: Flatten primary hit check to one cold exit; retain topology checks.
hypotheses.keys: Store primary origin inline as native does; retain managed leaf buffer indirection.
hypotheses.nomask: Use unconditional activity OR as selected native variant does.

excluded.bufferPointer: LeafManager swaps value arrays without topology changes; stale buffer risk.
excluded.versionRemoval: Managed references require existing topology invalidation; earlier churn cost rejected callbacks.

threshold: Screen: >=5% throughput gain in either coherent read/write; other coherent metric <=3% time regression. Confirmation: >=3% gain and all mandatory guardrails <=5% time regression.
budget: Screen 3 launches x 5 samples x 25,001,984 operations; 1500ms warmup, CPU8. Confirmation 5 launches; all samples retained. Churn 32768 operations.
observer: No profiler in timing runs; disassembly separate. Shared-host load uncontrolled.
statistics: Median of per-launch medians, descriptive comparisons; no independence/significance claim.
